summary: Mountaineer slipped on steep icy snowfield above Peacock Pool on the Chasm Lake/Mt. Meeker approach, fell ~100 ft and struck a rock, sustaining a deep thigh laceration; multi-agency litter evacuation took ~15 hours to reach the trailhead.
location: Chasm Lake area, Longs Peak Trailhead (Mt. Meeker Iron Gates approach), Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Larimer County Search and Rescue
notes: NPS morning report account (filed Thu Jan 13, 2011 — "last Saturday"; 22 rescuers carried R.S. ~3 mi to the Longs Peak Trailhead; SPOT activation) corroborates the RMRG incident-account version.
